title: Wheely Bits | Community (Slate & Sage)
prompt:
The Community Showcase page.
- Header: "Community Builds" in smooth, rounded typography.
- Filter Sidebar: Rounded checkboxes and tag-based filters (Aero, Suspension, etc.) using sage green accents.
- Grid: A gallery of community car builds. Each card has a large image, build title, and builder profile link.
- Trending: A sidebar for "Trending Tags" and "Top Builders".
- Animations: Cards should stagger-fade in on page load.

title: Wheely Bits | Home (Scrollable with Footer)
prompt:
Make the home page scrollable by adding content sections below the hero. Add a comprehensive footer at the bottom of the page that includes:
- Company branding: "Wheely Bits"
- Copyright: "© 2024 Wheely Bits. Precision Engineering & Design."
- Quick Links: "Terms of Service", "Privacy Policy", "Technical Support", "Vendor Portal", "FAQs"
- Social icons/links.
- Use the 'Slate & Sage' color palette (surface-container-lowest for footer background) and maintain the glassmorphic aesthetic.
- Ensure the overall page flow is smooth and supports vertical scrolling.

title: Wheely Bits | Home (with Hero Car)
prompt: In the hero section, add {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_20}} as a background image behind the large "WHEELY BITS" text. Ensure the image is center-aligned and has a subtle dark overlay (e.g., bg-black/40) so the text remains highly readable. The text should sit on top of the image. Keep the animated particle system if it exists, or layer it over the image.

title: Wheely Bits | Community (Daylight)
prompt:
Restyle the Community Hub into a bright, airy social feed.

Key Changes:
- Background: Off-white.
- Build Cards: White backgrounds with subtle shadows. Tags and owner info should be clearly legible against the white card surface.
- Filter Sidebar: Clean white surface with high-contrast text and orange checkboxes.
- Feed Layout: Maintain the masonry/grid but ensure the whitespace feels generous and clean.

title: Wheely Bits | Schedule Installation
prompt: A Booking & Scheduling screen for an automotive customization project. The UI features a split-screen layout. On the left, a calendar for date selection and a grid of available time slots. On the right, a 'Build Review' panel showing the selected service (e.g., 'British Racing Green Wrap'), the vendor (Aura Custom Studio), the estimated total cost, and a breakdown of the $50 refundable deposit. The style is 'Slate & Sage' with soft dark greens and greys, using a smooth sans-serif font.

title: Wheely Bits | My Profile
prompt:
PAGE 8: MY BUILDS (PROFILE). 
Header with user stats (Builds, Likes, Followers). 
Tabs: My Builds, Saved Rims, Wishlist. 
My Builds: Grid of user's saved configurations. 
Saved Rims: Technical cards for rims the user likes. 
Dark profile aesthetic with orange mesh accents.

title: Wheely Bits | Technical Guide: Wheel Offset (Slate & Sage)
prompt: A technical guide article screen within the Education Hub. The article title is 'Understanding Wheel Offset & Backspacing'. The layout features a large, cinematic header image of a high-performance rim. The content area is a centered, readable column with balanced typography. Include sections for 'What is Offset?', 'Positive vs. Negative', and 'How it Affects Fitment'. Use high-quality diagrams or placeholder areas for technical illustrations. Add a sidebar with 'Related Articles' like 'Bolt Pattern Guide' and 'Rim Width vs Tire Size'. Maintain the dark Slate & Sage theme with a floating centered nav bar.

title: Wheely Bits | Studio (Daylight)
prompt:
Transform the Studio interface into a light-themed "Daylight Studio". 

Key Changes:
- Editor Background: Change the grid background to a light neutral grey.
- Panels: Change the side and right panels from dark grey to crisp white or very light grey.
- Sidebar Icons: Use dark icons on light backgrounds, with the orange square active state.
- Rim Selection Grid: Card backgrounds should be white with light grey borders. Rim metadata (text) must be high-contrast dark grey.
- Controls: Floating UI elements should use light-mode glass-morphism (white blur).
- Active Indicators: Maintain the orange highlights for selected items and drag points.

title: Wheely Bits | Education Hub (Heritage)
prompt: Restyle the Education Hub with the 'Heritage Studio' design system. Light aesthetic with British Racing Green highlights. Update all module cards and the interactive rim diagram to match the new color palette and 'Outfit' font.

title: Wheely Bits | Vendors (Slate & Sage)
prompt: Wheely Bits Vendor Directory. A marketplace for finding trusted rim vendors and modification shops. Features: A searchable map interface (Islamabad/Rawalpindi region), featured vendor cards with ratings and services (rim vendors, wrap/tint, performance), and a 'Book Appointment' integration. Style: Clean UI with technical maps and Slate/Sage accents using Plus Jakarta Sans.
